fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-09-09, the grandfather of the complainant, Praveen Kumar, aged 67, left home for a bank visit and had not returned; last seen near Mathi Layout Apartment Complex. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-09-09 around 17:15 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Rajeshwari Rani (9000000291), a family member of Praveen Kumar, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000122. The family mentioned that Venkat Palanisamy (9000000134) was last known to be in contact with the missing person. Karthik Rajan (9000000091) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person last seen near a bus stop and could not be traced afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, elderly, evening, mobile number, apartment complex, CCTV, suspect, witness
